	if = { limit = { PAR = { is_subject_of = USA } } USA = { set_autonomy = { target = PAR autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { PAR = { is_subject_of = HOL } } HOL = { set_autonomy = { target = PAR autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { PAR = { is_subject_of = FRA } } FRA = { set_autonomy = { target = PAR autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { PAR = { is_subject_of = ITA } } ITA = { set_autonomy = { target = PAR autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { PAR = { is_subject_of = POR } } POR = { set_autonomy = { target = PAR autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { PAR = { is_subject_of = SPR } } SPR = { set_autonomy = { target = PAR autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = ENG } } ENG = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = SOV } } SOV = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = JAP } } JAP = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = USA } } USA = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = HOL } } HOL = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = FRA } } FRA = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = ITA } } ITA = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = POR } } POR = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	if = { limit = { BRA = { is_subject_of = SPR } } SPR = { set_autonomy = { target = BRA autonomy_state = autonomy_free } } }
	# Subjects of this world
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ROM NOT = { ROM = { is_subject_of = TUR } } } TUR = { puppet = ROM } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SAU NOT = { SAU = { is_subject_of = TUR } } } TUR = { puppet = SAU } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = QAT NOT = { QAT = { is_subject_of = PER } } } PER = { puppet = QAT } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF NOT = { SAF = { is_subject_of = ENG } } } ENG = { puppet = SAF } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = AST NOT = { AST = { is_subject_of = ENG } } } ENG = { puppet = AST } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN NOT = { CAN = { is_subject_of = ENG } } } ENG = { puppet = CAN } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = CSA NOT = { CSA = { is_subject_of = SPR } } } SPR = { puppet = CSA } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = VEN NOT = { VEN = { is_subject_of = GER } } } GER = { puppet = VEN } }
	# Starting alliances
	TUR = {
		create_faction = rpr_faction_red_ecumene
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ROM } add_to_faction = ROM }
	}
	PER = {
		create_faction = sao_faction_sacred_fire
		if = { limit = { country_exists = QAT } add_to_faction = QAT }
	}
	ENG = {
		create_faction = aw_faction_north_sea_thing
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF } add_to_faction = SAF }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AST } add_to_faction = AST }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN } add_to_faction = CAN }
	}
	# Wipe 1936 cores and claims-by-core; each country now holds cores on what it owns
	every_state = {
		every_country = {
			limit = { PREV = { is_core_of = PREV NOT = { is_owned_by = PREV } } }
			PREV = { remove_core_of = PREV }
		}
	}
	every_country = { every_owned_state = { add_core_of = PREV } }
}
